correctness.rationale: The rodent equations imply either zero force or the unique force (beta3*nu-(mu_r+nu)(mu_r+d_r))/(mu_r+d_r+nu)>0 when R_r>1. For any prescribed human force L, the remaining five equilibrium equations uniquely give E=L*S/A, I=p*L*S, Q=q*L*S, R=r*L*S and S=Lambda_h/(mu_h+(1-tau*q)L). Thus J=I/N=pL/(1+kL). For positive rodent force z, consistency L=z+beta2*J is equivalent to beta2=(1/p)(1-kz+kL-z/L), strictly increasing for L>=z because its derivative is (k+z/L^2)/p>0. This proves uniqueness, the sharp image [pz/(1+kz),p/k), and the inverse beta2=1/(p-kJ)-z/J. The rodent-free consistency L[1+kL-R_h]=0 proves the companion branch count, including equality thresholds. The bundled exact rational checker independently evaluates the full eight ODE residuals for a coexistence witness, a zero-contact endpoint, DFE, and a human-only endemic state; all returned exact zero. The analytic proof, not those finite tests, covers all positive parameter values.

originality.rationale: The strongest close comparator (Janan–Fatmawati–Hasan, 2026) already classifies disease-free, human-endemic and rodent-human coexistence branches for a DIFFERENT seven-state Mpox model with vaccination and asymptomatic infectious humans, and derives its own force quadratic. The qualitative taxonomy and existence thresholds alone are expressly not claimed as new. The motivating Arhinful–Anafo–Ampofi eight-state quarantine-return model prints only implicit endemic coordinates and R0=max(R_h,R_r); it does not derive the attained sharp lower prevalence floor, complete range as human contact varies, or its exact prevalence-to-contact inverse. Material inspection confirms that the Janan model's per-human-population zoonotic incidence and vaccination/asymptomatic compartments prevent its quadratic from directly implying this model-specific formula. Omede et al. include environmental and vertical transmission; Alharbi et al. use mass action. Source/formula/equivalence-focused published-finding searches found no equivalent coverage. The residual risk of an unindexed source-specific derivation remains explicit.
residual_risks: Janan et al. already prove the same qualitative three-branch taxonomy and a source-specific quadratic for a different model; only the target-specific sharp prevalence range and inverse control law are advanced as original.

The full Alharbi publisher PDF was not independently downloaded because of a rate-limiting response; accessible indexed primary equations show a distinctly different mass-action system, but the source's entire body was not reviewed.
Unindexed comments or model-specific notes may contain the exact inverse formula despite negative published-finding and exact-phrase searches.
The mathematical zero- and infinite-contact limits are not empirically validated intervention regimes.
No independent audit has been performed.

value.rationale: The source is motivated by separating human and zoonotic transmission control, yet its R0=max(R_h,R_r) and numerical sensitivity summaries do not quantify the best equilibrium prevalence attainable by reducing beta2 alone. The derived exact inverse beta2=1/(p-kJ)-z/J gives the full attainable interval and a positive sharp prevalence floor pz/(1+kz) under persistent infected rodents, with an exact positive-parameter witness where R_h=49/96<1 and R_r=2 while the human endemic prevalence remains positive. This is a motivated complete control-response invariant for this specific eight-state standard-incidence model, not simply a rephrased threshold, code certificate, arbitrary finite slice, or claim of broad epidemic novelty.
